products.title: LT-CT (Low Tension Current Transformer)
products.subtitle: High-Accuracy Current Measurement
products.description: Low Tension Current Transformers are precision instruments designed for accurate current measurement and protection in electrical systems up to 1kV. These transformers provide safe isolation between high current circuits and measuring instruments, ensuring accurate metering and protection relay operation.

features.title: High Accuracy Class
features.description: Meets accuracy class 0.2, 0.5, and 1.0 standards for precise current measurement and energy metering applications.

features.title: Electrical Isolation
features.description: Provides complete electrical isolation between primary and secondary circuits, ensuring operator safety and equipment protection.

features.title: Robust Construction
features.description: Built with high-quality materials and insulation systems designed for long-term reliability in low voltage applications.

faqs.question: What are the standard current ratios available?
faqs.answer: We offer a wide range of current ratios from 5/5A up to 4000/5A. Common ratios include 50/5A, 100/5A, 200/5A, 400/5A, 600/5A, 800/5A, 1000/5A, 1200/5A, 1500/5A, 2000/5A, 2500/5A, 3000/5A, and 4000/5A.

faqs.question: What accuracy class should I choose?
faqs.answer: Choose accuracy class based on your application: Class 0.2 for precision metering and billing, Class 0.5 for standard metering applications, and Class 1.0 for general protection and indication purposes.

faqs.question: Can these transformers be used outdoors?
faqs.answer: Standard LT-CTs are designed for indoor use. For outdoor applications, we offer weather-resistant enclosures and enhanced insulation systems suitable for various environmental conditions.

products.title: LT-PT (Low Tension Potential Transformer)
products.subtitle: Precise Voltage Measurement
products.description: Low Tension Potential Transformers are designed for accurate voltage measurement and monitoring in low voltage electrical networks. These instruments provide precise voltage scaling and electrical isolation, making them essential for metering, protection, and monitoring applications.

features.title: Precision Voltage Scaling
features.description: Accurately transforms primary voltage to standard secondary values (110V or 100V) for measurement and protection devices.

features.title: Galvanic Isolation
features.description: Provides complete electrical isolation between high voltage primary and low voltage secondary circuits.

features.title: Long-term Stability
features.description: Designed for stable performance over extended periods with minimal drift in accuracy and phase angle.

faqs.question: What are the standard voltage ratios available?
faqs.answer: Common voltage ratios include 110V/110V, 220V/110V, 380V/110V, 400V/110V, 415V/110V, 440V/110V, 480V/110V, 600V/110V, and 690V/110V. Custom ratios are available upon request.

faqs.question: What is the difference between single-phase and three-phase PTs?
faqs.answer: Single-phase PTs are used for individual phase voltage measurement, while three-phase PTs can measure line-to-line or line-to-neutral voltages in three-phase systems. Three-phase units are more compact for multi-phase applications.

faqs.question: How do I select the appropriate burden rating?
faqs.answer: The burden rating should exceed the total VA consumption of all connected meters, relays, and instruments. Consider a safety margin of 25-50% above the calculated total burden.

products.title: MV-CT (Medium Voltage Current Transformer)
products.subtitle: Robust Current Sensing Solutions
products.description: Medium Voltage Current Transformers are engineered for accurate current sensing in medium voltage systems up to 33kV. These robust instruments are essential for protection, metering, and monitoring in substations, industrial facilities, and distribution networks.

features.title: High Voltage Insulation
features.description: Advanced insulation systems designed to withstand medium voltage levels up to 33kV with excellent dielectric properties.

features.title: Multi-Core Design
features.description: Available with multiple secondary windings for simultaneous metering and protection applications with different accuracy requirements.

features.title: Overcurrent Protection
features.description: Designed to handle high fault currents and provide accurate measurement even under extreme conditions.

faqs.question: What types of MV-CT construction are available?
faqs.answer: We offer various constructions including cast resin, oil-filled, and SF6 insulated types. Cast resin types are maintenance-free and environmentally friendly, while oil-filled types offer superior performance for high current applications.

faqs.question: What is the difference between metering and protection cores?
faqs.answer: Metering cores (Class 0.2S, 0.5) provide high accuracy under normal operating conditions. Protection cores (Class 5P10, 5P20) maintain accuracy during fault conditions and can handle higher overcurrents.

faqs.question: How are MV-CTs installed in switchgear?
faqs.answer: MV-CTs can be installed as bushing-type (through existing bushings), window-type (cable pass-through), or outdoor post-type depending on the application and switchgear configuration.

products.title: MV-PT (Medium Voltage Potential Transformer)
products.subtitle: Precision Voltage Measurement
products.description: Medium Voltage Potential Transformers provide precise voltage measurement in medium voltage distribution systems. These high-performance instruments are crucial for accurate metering, protection relay operation, and system monitoring in substations and industrial facilities.

features.title: High Precision Measurement
features.description: Excellent accuracy and thermal stability for reliable voltage measurement across the entire operating range.

features.title: Superior Insulation System
features.description: Advanced insulation materials and design provide reliable operation in medium voltage environments up to 33kV.

features.title: Multiple Configuration Options
features.description: Available in single-phase and three-phase configurations with various connection options to suit different applications.

faqs.question: What are the standard secondary voltage ratings?
faqs.answer: Standard secondary voltages are 110V for single-phase and 110V (line-to-neutral) or 110/√3V for three-phase applications. Special secondary voltages like 100V or 120V are available upon request.

faqs.question: What insulation types are available?
faqs.answer: We offer cast resin (dry-type), oil-filled, and SF6 gas insulated designs. Cast resin types are maintenance-free and environmentally friendly, suitable for indoor installations.

faqs.question: How do I determine the required burden capacity?
faqs.answer: Calculate the total VA consumption of all connected instruments, meters, and relays. Select a PT with burden capacity 25-50% higher than this total to ensure stable operation and accommodate future additions.

products.title: R.V.T/Earthing Transformer
products.subtitle: Neutral Earthing Solutions
products.description: Residual Voltage Transformers and Earthing Transformers provide essential neutral earthing solutions for three-phase electrical systems. These transformers create an artificial neutral point in ungrounded systems and detect earth faults, ensuring system safety and protection.

features.title: Earth Fault Detection
features.description: Enables detection of single-phase earth faults in isolated neutral systems, providing early warning of insulation problems.

features.title: Artificial Neutral Creation
features.description: Creates a stable neutral point in three-phase systems without a natural neutral, enabling proper earthing and protection.

features.title: Voltage Stabilization
features.description: Provides voltage stability during unbalanced conditions and single-phase earth faults in the electrical network.

faqs.question: What is the difference between RVT and Earthing Transformer?
faqs.answer: RVT (Residual Voltage Transformer) detects earth faults by measuring zero-sequence voltage. Earthing Transformer provides an artificial neutral point for system earthing. They can be combined in a single unit.

faqs.question: Why is neutral earthing important?
faqs.answer: Neutral earthing limits overvoltages during earth faults, enables selective protection coordination, reduces risk of multiple earth faults, and provides a reference point for system operation.

faqs.question: How do I select the earthing resistance value?
faqs.answer: Earthing resistance selection depends on fault current requirements, relay sensitivity, and system protection philosophy. Common values range from 10Ω (high resistance) to 100Ω (medium resistance) earthing.

products.title: Outdoor Transformer
products.subtitle: Weather-Resistant Power Solutions
products.description: Outdoor Transformers are specifically designed to withstand harsh environmental conditions while maintaining reliable operation. With superior insulation and weatherproof construction, these transformers are ideal for substations, industrial facilities, and outdoor installations.

features.title: All-Weather Protection
features.description: IP54/IP65 rated enclosures provide complete protection against dust, moisture, rain, and extreme weather conditions.

features.title: Enhanced Insulation System
features.description: Superior insulation materials and design withstand temperature variations, UV radiation, and environmental stresses.

features.title: Optimized Cooling Design
features.description: Advanced cooling systems ensure optimal operating temperature even in high ambient conditions and direct sunlight exposure.

faqs.question: What makes outdoor transformers different from indoor ones?
faqs.answer: Outdoor transformers have weatherproof enclosures, enhanced insulation systems, UV-resistant materials, corrosion-resistant components, and are designed to handle wider temperature ranges and environmental stresses.

faqs.question: What maintenance is required for outdoor transformers?
faqs.answer: Regular maintenance includes checking oil level and quality, inspecting bushings and gaskets, cleaning insulators, checking cooling systems, and monitoring for signs of corrosion or weather damage.

faqs.question: Can outdoor transformers operate in coastal environments?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer special coastal versions with enhanced corrosion protection, salt-resistant coatings, and improved sealing systems designed specifically for high-salinity environments.

products.title: Control Transformer
products.subtitle: Precision Control Circuit Power
products.description: Control Transformers provide stable, precise voltage supply for control circuits and instrumentation in industrial automation systems. These transformers ensure reliable operation of control devices, PLCs, sensors, and other critical control equipment.

features.title: Voltage Regulation
features.description: Excellent voltage regulation maintains stable output voltage under varying load conditions, ensuring consistent control circuit operation.

features.title: Electrical Isolation
features.description: Provides galvanic isolation between power and control circuits, protecting sensitive control equipment from electrical disturbances.

features.title: Built-in Protection
features.description: Integrated overcurrent protection and thermal protection safeguard both the transformer and connected control equipment.

specifications.insulation_class: Class B, Class F, Class H

faqs.question: What are the common secondary voltage ratings?
faqs.answer: Standard secondary voltages include 12V, 24V (most common for control circuits), 48V, 110V, and 120V. Multiple secondary windings are available for applications requiring different voltage levels.

faqs.question: How do I calculate the required VA rating?
faqs.answer: Sum the VA consumption of all connected control devices (contactors, relays, PLCs, indicators, etc.) and add 25-30% safety margin. Consider inrush currents for electromagnetic devices.

faqs.question: What protection features are available?
faqs.answer: Available protection includes primary and secondary fuses, thermal overload protection, circuit breakers, and surge protection devices. Some models include built-in indication lights for status monitoring.
